source.title: 2026 non-domestic rating list, compiled summary valuations (baseline epoch 0003), City of London office aggregation for the Cheapside/Gresham/Wood, Old Bailey/Ludgate/Fleet Place and Cannon Street corridors

_method: Same method as seed_voa_cw_2026list.json: each figure is the building's aggregate rateable value divided by aggregate floor area across the office hereditaments matched to it (record type 01, description containing 'Office', street name plus trailing street number, with named exceptions recorded per building). Values are GBP per square metre on the list's antecedent valuation date of 1 April 2024. Counts of 1-4 are whole-building or multi-floor assessments embedding quantum discounts; large counts are floor-by-floor multi-lets, sometimes including serviced suites. 99 City Road (an Endurance Land / Nan Fung holding under redevelopment) has no matchable office assessment in the 2026 list and so carries no figure. An un-numbered 4,078 m2 '3rd-5th floors' block on Ludgate Hill could not be attributed to a named building and was excluded.
